157879: Sui is a slime that Mukoda took as his second familiar. At the time when he got as a familiar, Sui was just a baby slime but evolved on the third day.
157880: Ninrir is the Goddess of Wind and the Fenrirs are her descendants. She gave Mukouda her blessing in order to extort offerings from him. She's weak to otherworld sweets, especially dorayaki.
157881: A salaryman summoned from modern Japan. He possesses the unique skill, "Online Supermarket", which allows him to buy goods from modern Japan any time, any place. The food he buys with his skill has buffing effects, making anyone who eats it become much stronger than before.
157882: Fel is a Fenrir who is considered a legendary magical beast, one of the descendants of the Goddess of the Wind, Ninrir. Formed a contract with Mukouda and became his first familiar due to his great interest in his cooking. Fel absolutely hates vegetables and prefers to eat meat.
199866: Agni is the Goddess of Fire. She gave Mukouda her blessing so that she could get offerings from him. Agni likes otherworld alcohol, especially beer.
199867: A pixie dragon that Mukouda took as his third familiar. Despite his very small stature, he is very strong when it comes to combat. Dora can use all kinds of elemental magic, such as fire, wind, water, earth and thunder.
245610: Kisharle is the Goddess of Earth. She gave Mukouda her blessing so she could receive his offerings. She's entranced by the effects of the otherworld's beauty products.
245613: Rusalka is the Goddess of Water. She gave Mukouda's familiar, Sui, her blessing so that she could receive offerings from Mukouda. She absolutely loves eating food from the otherworld.
245634: Vahagn is the God of War. A fearless man of large build. After finding out the source of Agni's otherwordly alcohol, he gave Fel and Dora-chan his blessing so that he could receive offerings from Mukouda. He is particularly fond of stronger liquors with very high alcohol levels.
245639: Hephaestos is the God of Blacksmith. A short muscular old man. After finding out the source of Agni's otherwordly alcohol, he gave Sui his blessing so that he could receive offerings from Mukouda. He is particularly fond of stronger liquors with very high alcohol levels.
267485: The adventurer's guild master for Dungeon Town Doran. He is normally a brilliant individual, but he loses control when it comes to dragons.
